widgets_values:
1. Upload an approved photo in 01. SOURCE=true uses it directly; false runs the original base generator below.
2. Edit COMMON DESCRIPTION and four PANEL prompts. There is no automatic captioning.
3. Run: source, generated grid, four separately finished panels, and a small contact sheet are saved.
4. Denoise 0.40 is a starting point. Raise slightly for more pose change; lower for more preservation.
5. CAROUSEL DEPTH defaults OFF; it repeats the source depth in four cells and can restrict pose changes.
6. Color Match and final refinement/upscale have independent switches. KRAST SoftFace is OFF.
7. Final extraction uses an exact 2x2 split. Inspect the AutoGrid red-box preview: if the model creates a malformed layout, fix prompt/denoise and regenerate.
8. GRID BUDGET is for all four panels. Lowering it reduces per-panel detail. Dimensions align to 64 pixels before VAE encoding.
9. The optional original base generator has its own prompt and depth controls. With SOURCE=true it is not sampled.
Requires the same model files as your source workflow, KJNodes and current ComfyUI-AutoGrid. See UPUTSTVO.md.
